title: ジャパンCの後に・Das Wachstum

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Thanks for racing with me today! What are you planning to run next?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Um, I was thinking of the Arima Kinen…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Really? I was thinking of running that too! Here's to having another good race if we end up in it together!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I had a lot of fun racing with you today!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Oh, same here! I'm looking forward to next time!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: So this is what the senior racers are capable of…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: (Despite their strength, I managed to triumph over them! I've improved so much!)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes! I even defeated the older students!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: However, they were daunting foes. I must become better still for next time.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It seems both Spe and Rob Roy intend to run in the Arima Kinen.
choice_data_list: Guess you'll be seeing them on the track again, huh?
Guess you'll be seeing them on the track again, huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen is next up on Eishin Flash's schedule. The three of them will undoubtedly clash again the way things are now.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It is safe to assume that they will be my greatest adversaries in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: So in order to win, all I must do is outrun those two again. It's great when things are so simple.
